variables.description: elusion flow runs as Kubernetes Jobs (phase 6). Based on prefect-kubernetes 0.8.0's default template; see the comment in templates/prefect-register.yaml for what changed.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name given to infrastructure created by a worker.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Environment variables to set when starting a flow run.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels applied to infrastructure created by a worker.

command.title: Command
command.description: Leave blank: the worker fills in `prefect flow-run execute`.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Annotations applied to Kubernetes jobs and pods created by the worker.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace to create jobs within.

image.title: Image
image.description: The elusion image, set by the chart.

finished_job_ttl.title: Finished Job TTL
finished_job_ttl.description: Seconds before a finished Job is deleted; null keeps it for inspection.

job_watch_timeout_seconds.title: Job Watch Timeout Seconds
job_watch_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to watch for job creation before timing out; null waits forever.

pod_watch_timeout_seconds.title: Pod Watch Timeout Seconds
pod_watch_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to watch for pod creation before timing out (an image pull on a new node takes a while).

stream_output.title: Stream Output
stream_output.description: Stream the flow run's output to the worker's log.

cluster_config.title: Cluster Config
cluster_config.description: Null: the worker uses its in-cluster credentials.

cpu_request.title: CPU Request
cpu_request.description: CPU request for the flow-run container.

cpu_limit.title: CPU Limit
cpu_limit.description: CPU limit for the flow-run container.

memory_request.title: Memory Request
memory_request.description: Memory request for the flow-run container.

memory_limit.title: Memory Limit
memory_limit.description: Memory limit for the flow-run container.
